result: If I could change the world in one way, I’d wish for every person to truly master the art of deep listening — not just waiting to speak, but hearing the stories, fears, and hopes beneath the words. So much conflict grows from misunderstanding, and so much loneliness fades when someone feels truly heard. In a world rich with noise, a little more quiet attention might help us see each other as more than strangers — as threads in the same tapestry, each carrying a universe within.
